Text: WHEN the POS sends a completed purchase event, the loyalty service shall create a pending points transaction for the member.
Criterion: Given a registered member, when the POS sends one completed purchase event for that member, then a pending points transaction for that purchase and member exists.
Test idea: Send a sample purchase event in the S-02 JSON format to the event consumer; expect one Pending transaction that references the purchase ID.

Text: The loyalty service shall award 1 point per SGD 1 of the purchase amount, rounded down per transaction.
Criterion: For purchase amounts SGD 0.99, 1.00 and 150.75 the awarded points are 0, 1 and 150.
Test idea: Table-driven test of the points calculation.

Text: The loyalty service shall award double points on the member's birthday.
Criterion: On the member's birthday, a purchase of SGD 10 earns 20 points.
Test idea: Unit test with a fixed clock on the birthday.
